reason: A user-interface plugin that declutters the settings panel by folding plugin entries into collapsible and user-managed groups, with persistent local configuration.

summaries.zh: 通过折叠插件设置入口并支持创建可管理的自定义分组，帮助整理和简化设置面板导航。
summaries.en: Organizes the settings panel by folding plugin entries into collapsible groups and supporting user-managed custom groupings.

capabilities: Reorganizes settings navigation entries into collapsible groups
Adds settings controls for folding and managing custom groups
Persists group configuration and fold state in localStorage
Observes settings navigation updates and adjusts the rendered panel
